scope:
Independent CPU evidence receipts for terminal calibration/pilot attempts.

Reuses the previous study's trusted reconstruction/checkpoint/video bindings.
Default inspect does not load checkpoints or hash corpora. --execute is reserved
for an explicit post-pilot trigger; failed attempts retain their qualification.
No recording is changed, no policy is run, and no video is decoded.

protocol.scope: Current workspace and frozen .source bytes only; not runtime mapped-library or complete model-input capture

event_reconstruction.scope: Independent event reconstruction; causal bounds and immutable IDs audited. Full tensor/continuity/codec validation remains the recorded SDK/production qualification.

full_video_evidence.scope: Full sequential software YUV decode plus exact compressed/metadata hashes; not lossless RGB fidelity or every SDK temporal seek.
